# Bloub animation core

Vendored from https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub at revision
`b4bb3c1b5f93c7b87a2e8d620f667c4093d97749` (MIT, Jérémy Perret).
Only the framework-independent animation engine and its dependencies are included.
Formatting follows Aether's formatter; upstream comments are retained. Vue, demo UI,
export tools and network dependencies are not included. See LICENSE and the packaged
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Aether's React renderer, state mapping, colors and custom
radial body are in src/companion and are maintained separately.
